verdict.rationale: Long-term support for older major versions is a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence pack has no documented security-maintenance or LTS policy for older Svelte majors such as Svelte 4. The only related items are a migration note about reusing Svelte 4 syntax knowledge and community comments about breaking changes, and neither addresses security updates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can continue receiving security updates for an older major version while I plan my migration
